headline: Brunei's sultan announces cabinet shake-up, appoints sons as ministers
summary: Brunei's ruler announced a major cabinet reshuffle creating new key portfolios and appointing two younger sons as ministers. It is the first shake-up since 2022 and comes amid a global energy crisis.
why: Brunei is an oil and gas producer, and its government policy affects energy output and fiscal planning. Leadership changes can signal shifts in economic policy.
